scopes.title: Selected scalar constants and mass-density inputs
scopes.checked_claim: Selected SI/IAU/CODATA definitions and source epochs are retained separately from engine choices. Neutral isotope masses reported by Pitrou Table 10, native pure-H mass m_p+m_e-B1/c^2 and caller-declared H/He effective masses are distinct. n_H=rho_b(1-Y_m)/m_H and n_He=rho_b Y_m/m_He require the declared effective mass convention. pc=(648000/pi) au and au=149597870700 m are exact relations; a finite decimal pc approximation is not exact. CODATA 2018 G has a supplied uncertainty column with unverified interpretation; the 2022 interpretation cannot be borrowed.
scopes.unresolved: No universal isotope input/default, BBN abundance prediction, joint covariance or background consistency is qualified. The kg/u conversion is evaluated, not exact; no mixed-epoch kg mass scalar is generated.

scopes.title: Conditional late Thomson depth and distinct drag weighting
scopes.checked_claim: Ordinary Thomson q_z=c sigma_T n_e/[H(1+z)], tau_0(z)=integral_0^z q_z dz and g_z=q_z exp(-tau_0) use the today boundary. CLASS emits a positive collision rate and visibility per conformal length; per-redshift visibility needs the absolute Jacobian. If a qualified finite 0<=L<=U encloses the omitted late depth, tau_0 lies in [tau_B+L,tau_B+U], with survival/visibility bounds from the monotone exponential. The finite-interval visibility mass retains both missing late scope and upper survival; no normalization to one. reio_none returns xe_before, not zero electrons.
scopes.unresolved: The actual L and U are null: no matching qualified late-electron history or deterministic envelope is supplied. Today depth/visibility remain blocked. Drag requires its separate weighted tail integral q_z/R_b with R_b=3 rho_b/(4 rho_gamma); an unweighted Thomson interval does not determine physical drag, a root or r_d. No CMB or full CLASS equivalence is accepted.
